parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the kitchen pot, made of tempered glass with a plastic handle on top. It is circular and fits snugly on the pot body.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spills and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move independently during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum with a handle and an electric heating base. It is cylindrical and serves as the main cooking vessel.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds food and liquid for cooking, distributes heat evenly, and provides structural support for the lid and handle.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or moved when cooking is complete.
